title: The Poles: a new ending (the plan and script)
kaylee: She flies Sparkle's balloon down the world, sings in the dark to light the way and gather every friend, leads Pebble through a huddle of a thousand dads to Papa as the sun comes up, then flies Pola home with a pebble to remember him by.

pictures.title: 1. Hold to Fly
pictures.caption: She pilots the balloon: hold to rise, let go to sink, ride the pink wind south. The Arctic, the warm middle, the red ship, then a blizzard.

pictures.title: 2. The storm
pictures.caption: The balloon goes down in a whiteout. Pebble gives up, Pola says Mama's 'Friends help friends', and Pebble remembers Papa's song.

pictures.title: 3. Sing in the Dark
pictures.caption: Hold Pebble to sing: a ring of song lights up the dark. Every friend it finds joins in, until the song crosses Antarctica and Papa answers.

pictures.title: 4. Through the Huddle
pictures.caption: She leads Pebble through a churning huddle of dads by Papa's gold notes. The biggest song opens the huddle, and her finger tucks Pebble onto Papa's feet.

pictures.title: 5. Sunrise
pictures.caption: They meet as the sun comes back after months of night. Papa meets a polar bear, and the whole colony sings the song.

pictures.title: 6. Goodbye
pictures.caption: Pebble gives Pola a pebble; she flies Pola home to Mama. Top and bottom of the world at once: 'They never meet...' 'Except best friends!'

questions: Emperor Huddle stops being its own chapter (its play lives on inside the finale's Act 3). OK?
Terry's quiz goes away (each fact becomes something she does). OK?
Pebble's goodbye gift to Pola is a pebble. Keep it, or something else?
